changelog: Notes+ 21.0: Ultimate notes. Words, checklists, mind maps, voice notes, days and pictures on one page, and anything inside anything (type / to add one). Install over this version; don't uninstall first.

desktop.changelog: Notes+ 21.0 for Windows: Ultimate notes (everything on one page, anything inside anything), and the formatting bar now stays fixed and solid above the page.

linux.changelog: Notes+ 21.0 for Linux: Ultimate notes (everything on one page, anything inside anything), and the formatting bar now stays fixed and solid above the page.

web.changelog: Notes+ on the web 21.0: Ultimate notes. Everything on one page, and anything inside anything.
